title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
evidence_note: Memory stream, relevance/recency/importance retrieval, and evidence-linked reflections; component ablations evaluate believable behavior.
limitation: Short simulated-world study; retrieval errors and fabricated embellishments remain; not a project-handoff evaluation.
review_level: targeted full-text architecture, evaluation, and limitations sections

title: MemoryBank: Enhancing Large Language Models with Long-Term Memory
venue_or_status: First public preprint 2023; AAAI 2024; preprint v3 reviewed
evidence_note: Stores conversations, event summaries, and personality summaries; optional time/reinforcement forgetting; companion evaluation.
limitation: Generated dialogue probes and qualitative companion evidence do not establish accurate project continuity or trustworthy personality inference.
review_level: targeted full-text storage, retrieval, updating, and evaluation sections

title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
venue_or_status: arXiv first submitted October 2023; v2 February 2024
evidence_note: Agent-directed functions page information into context; original queue messages survive in recall storage; chat and document experiments.
limitation: Tool-use capability and stopping policy affect retrieval; baseline context differences and old model configurations limit transfer.
review_level: targeted full-text architecture and experiment sections

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
evidence_note: Reflective text about task feedback persists into later trials; evaluated across coding, reasoning, and decision-making tasks.
limitation: Learning across attempts differs from faithfully preserving a full evolving project state; internal reflections can misdiagnose failure.
review_level: targeted full-text mechanism and evaluation sections; proceedings status checked

title: Evaluating Very Long-Term Conversational Memory of LLM Agents
evidence_note: Persona/event-grounded machine-human conversations evaluate QA, summaries, and multimodal dialogue generation.
limitation: Small constructed corpus; using only QA does not validate all benchmark tasks or real tool-driven project continuation.
review_level: targeted proceedings PDF abstract, dataset, and evaluation sections

title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
venue_or_status: First public preprint 2024; ICLR 2025; arXiv v2 reviewed
evidence_note: Prepared long histories with evidence annotations test five abilities and support indexing/retrieval/reading analyses.
limitation: Question answering over prepared histories does not test concurrent writes, continuous preservation, or actual task resumption.
review_level: targeted full-text benchmark and design-choice sections; official dataset format checked

title: On Memory Construction and Retrieval for Personalized Conversational Agents
venue_or_status: SeCom, ICLR 2025; arXiv v3 reviewed; OpenReview direct page challenged browser
evidence_note: Compares memory granularities; compressed indexing denoises retrieval while original topical segments supply response context.
limitation: Benchmark and segmentation-model dependence; successful compression does not guarantee preservation for every query.
review_level: targeted full-text granularity analysis, system description, and evaluation sections

title: A-Mem: Agentic Memory for LLM Agents
venue_or_status: NeurIPS 2025; April 2025 arXiv v4 inspected; proceedings metadata checked
evidence_note: Generated contextual notes, links, and neighboring-note evolution; LoCoMo evaluation and component ablations.
limitation: Generated structure depends on base-model quality; linking/evolution is not independent verification of note assertions.
review_level: targeted full-text methodology, ablation, hyperparameter, and limitation sections

title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory
evidence_note: Incremental salient-fact extraction and update operations; graph variant invalidates obsolete relationships; LoCoMo comparisons.
limitation: Vendor evaluation, model/judge/protocol dependence, and potential extraction loss; title does not establish production reliability.
review_level: targeted full-text pipeline, graph variant, benchmark, and update algorithm sections

title: Zep: A Temporal Knowledge Graph Architecture for Agent Memory
evidence_note: Raw episodes, semantic entities/relations, communities, event/ingestion timelines, and source indices; DMR/LongMemEval evaluation.
limitation: Source-link traversal not directly examined in paper experiments; vendor claims and retained raw episodes do not prove complete extraction.
review_level: targeted full-text graph construction, temporal model, provenance, and benchmark sections

title: A Human-Inspired Reading Agent with Gist Memory of Very Long Contexts
evidence_note: Episodes become gists that guide interactive lookups in original documents; evaluated on three comprehension tasks.
limitation: Static document reading differs from evolving conversational state and project handoff; lookup decisions remain model-dependent.
review_level: targeted full-text architecture and experiment sections; proceedings metadata checked

title: Towards Lifelong Dialogue Agents via Timeline-based Memory Management
evidence_note: Retains old memories, connects temporal/causal relations, and retrieves timelines; counterfactual-driven TeaFarm evaluation.
limitation: Generated causal relations and current-state interpretation require scrutiny; evaluation is conversational response generation.
review_level: primary abstract and indexed paper introduction/method excerpts

title: Filesystem-Based Memory for LLM Agents: Organization, Evolution, and Sustainability
evidence_note: Varies roles, store shapes, models, tools, and stream scale; distinguishes answer quality from search economy and store health.
limitation: Conversation evaluation includes a held-out LoCoMo conversation; tested organization did not itself improve conversational answers; generalization is open.
review_level: targeted full-text abstract, setup, research-question structure, and conclusions

title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
venue_or_status: arXiv v1, September 3, 2026; author metadata says accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings, not verified as published proceedings
evidence_note: Parallel examiners distinguish store presence, native retrieval evidence, and oracle-evidence answering; evaluated across seven systems.
limitation: Diagnostic search uses privileged source evidence and depends on store observability, annotation, and examiner reliability.
review_level: targeted full-text abstract, diagnostic inputs, examiner definitions, and attribution mechanism

title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
venue_or_status: arXiv first submitted June 4, 2026; v2 September 22, 2026
evidence_note: Phase-aware characterization separates write/read/generation costs; asynchronous construction exposes stale-memory serving.
limitation: Selected benchmark, scheduling, model, and hardware configurations bound transfer to other deployments.
review_level: targeted full-text taxonomy, pipeline, workload setup, freshness study, and recommendations

title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
evidence_note: Event-grounded property graph preserves revisions; retrieval agent combines entity lookup, structured traversal, and hybrid search.
limitation: Construction cost, resolution errors, ontology fit, and base-model tool use limit reliability; evaluated mainly as QA.
review_level: targeted proceedings PDF architecture, conclusions, and limitations sections

title: Memory tool — Claude Platform Docs
venue_or_status: Living official documentation inspected October 8, 2026; tool schema memory_20250818; year records inspection rather than original publication
evidence_note: Specifies persistent client-side memory file operations, startup inspection, and application responsibility for storage/path controls.
limitation: Interface/prompt guidance, not empirical fidelity evidence; page can change and leaves content-maintenance policy to implementers.
review_level: official overview, operations, prompting guidance, and path-validation sections

title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
evidence_note: Fixed-reader context-gathering evaluation over web-agent trajectories; AgentRunbook-C stores trajectories, manifests, notes, and inspection scripts.
limitation: QA rather than resumed execution; selected web environments; coding-agent retrieval adds substantial latency.
review_level: targeted full-text introduction and evaluation formulation; official project baseline description

title: AMemGym: Interactive Memory Benchmarking for Assistants in Long-Horizon Conversations
venue_or_status: arXiv v1, March 2, 2026; author metadata says accepted to ICLR 2026
evidence_note: Structured user profiles/states ground interactive simulated conversations, allowing assistant choices to shape later interactions.
limitation: Simulator and schema assumptions; does not directly establish human collaboration or repository-maintenance performance.
review_level: primary abstract, introduction, and on-policy/off-policy motivation

title: Does Memory Need Graphs? A Unified Framework and Empirical Analysis for Long-Term Dialog Memory
evidence_note: Stage-wise experiments align representations, organization, maintenance, and retrieval; graph benefits depend on implementation choices.
limitation: Framework and configurations are incomplete; dataset/extraction granularity affects metrics; no universal graph/non-graph winner.
review_level: targeted proceedings PDF framework, experimental settings, conclusion, and limitations
